description: This file is a Python script named 'gdbclient.py' used for managing debugging sessions with Android devices, including functions for attaching debuggers, fetching binaries, configuring LLDB, and interacting with the device during development and troubleshooting.

methods.name: read_toolchain_config(root)
methods.description: Finds out the current toolchain version by executing a Python script within the build directory and capturing its output.

methods.name: get_lldb_path(toolchain_path)
methods.description: Locates the LLDB debugger binary within the provided toolchain directory by checking common names.

methods.name: get_lldb_server_path(root, clang_base, clang_version, arch)
methods.description: Constructs the path to the lldb-server binary for a specific architecture based on root, clang version, and architecture.

methods.name: get_tracer_pid(device, pid)
methods.description: Retrieves the TracerPid from the process's status file on the device to determine if tracing is active.

methods.name: parse_args()
methods.description: Defines and parses command-line arguments for attaching to processes, running commands, setting up forwarding, and environment configuration.

methods.name: verify_device(root, device)
methods.description: Checks whether the connected device matches the expected TARGET_PRODUCT and TARGET_DEVICE environment variables.

methods.name: get_remote_pid(device, process_name)
methods.description: Retrieves the process ID of a named process on the device, handling multiple matches and errors.

methods.name: make_temp_dir(prefix)
methods.description: Creates a temporary directory for linker or debugger files and keeps track of it for cleanup.

methods.name: ensure_linker(device, sysroot, interp)
methods.description: Ensures the device's linker binary exists at a suitable location on the host for debugging, copying or pulling it if necessary.

methods.name: handle_switches(args, sysroot)
methods.description: Determines which binary or process to attach to based on command-line arguments, fetching binaries as needed.

methods.name: generate_vscode_lldb_script(root, sysroot, binary_name, port, solib_search_path)
methods.description: Creates a JSON configuration for attaching LLDB through VSCode using the specified parameters.

methods.name: generate_lldb_script(root, sysroot, binary_name, port, solib_search_path)
methods.description: Generates plain LLDB commands for connecting to the debugging target.

methods.name: generate_setup_script(debugger_path, sysroot, linker_search_dir, binary_file, is64bit, port, debugger, connect_timeout=5)
methods.description: Produces a setup script with search paths and commands tailored for the debugger type (LLDB or VSCode LLDB).

methods.name: do_main()
methods.description: Main orchestration function that manages environment checks, argument parsing, binary fetching, debugger setup, and launching or connecting the debugger.

methods.name: main()
methods.description: Entry point that executes do_main and performs cleanup of temporary directories.

ctags.name: generate_setup_script
ctags.pattern: /^def generate_setup_script(debugger_path, sysroot, linker_search_dir, binary_file, is64bit, port,/
ctags.signature: (debugger_path, sysroot, linker_search_dir, binary_file, is64bit, port, debugger, connect_timeout=5)
